svg.text: Dash computer: Pi 5, screen, cameras, USB, audio
Teryx OS wiring, sheet 'dash'. Made from config/wiring.yaml by `python -m teryx wiring`. Don't edit this file.
Labels: wire id, size, fuse (if the wire has its own), and anything in between. Faded = optional. Hover for notes. Full table: docs/wiring/README.md

g.title: X03: CAM_REAR.USB -> PI5.USB3_A - Or a UVC capture dongle if it's an RCA/AHD camera
X04: TCAM_DONGLE.USB -> PI5.USB3_B - Other USB controller from the rear camera
X13: AIHAT.PCIE -> PI5.PCIE - Keep the PCIe port free for this
X14: AIHAT.HDR -> PI5.HAT_HDR - 16 mm stacking header over the Active Cooler
PI5: Raspberry Pi 5 8GB - The 40-pin header and the PCIe port are kept for the AI HAT+ 2. CAN module wires go to header pins that come up through the HAT
g.text: HAT_HDR 40-pin header to the 16 mm sta…

g.title: SCREEN: 10.1 in touch screen - 1280x800, HDMI + USB touch, 3.5 mm audio in
USB_HUB: Powered USB hub - For the slow USB things. Not picked yet, power feed TBC
CAM_FRONT: Camera Module 3 Wide (front) - Inside the screen housing, 200-300 mm ribbon
CAM_CABIN: Cabin camera (sentry) - Being worked out in the 4G / sentry thread. Port TBC
AIHAT: AI HAT+ 2 (later) - Not buying yet. Room, cooling (about 4.5 W) and the PCIe port stay free for it
PI_CAN: MCP2515 CAN module (Pi) - Seeed MCP2515 + SN65HVD230 on the Pi box wall

MODEM_4G: SIMCom A7670SA 4G board - 6-pin header S G V K T R G. V takes 5-10 V from the spare Mini560 5 V buck. NEVER raw 12 V (10 V max, and the car runs 14.4 V with spikes). K is tied to ground on the board, so it starts by itself. T/R are 115200 baud TTL to the Pi's GPIO 15/14; measure T before connecting (3.3 V ok, else BSS138). Micro USB also on board
SSD: USB SSD (recordings) - Only if we record footage. Shares the hub's bandwidth; never NVMe on the PCIe port
